claims.text: The hotel overlooks the Petronas Twin Towers and is adjacent to the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre.

findings.quote: Overlooking the iconic Petronas Twin Towers and adjacent to Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur is one of the best hotels in the city

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle shopping, dining and entertainment district.

findings.quote: within walking distance of the Golden Triangle shopping, dining and entertainment district
This elegant 47-square-meter room overlooks KLCC Park
findings.note: The Garden View room overlooks KLCC Park.

claims.text: The Grand Suite has a living room and a round marble bathtub.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in this 105-square-meter suite with city views, one king bed, a living room and a luxurious bathroom fitted with a round marble bathtub.
findings.note: Grand Suite description includes both features.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge offers personalized check-in and check-out, complimentary breakfast, all-day refreshments and evening cocktails with canapes.

findings.quote: offering exclusive benefits such as personalized check-in and check-out, complimentary breakfast, all-day refreshments, and evening cocktails with canapés.

claims.text: There is a wading pool for children, with complimentary kids' amenities.

findings.quote: We also offer a wading pool ideal for children with a depth of 0.45 metres and complimentary kids’ amenities.

claims.text: The fitness centre has Technogym cardiovascular and strength-training machines.

findings.quote: well-appointed with the latest cardiovascular and strength-training Technogym machines

claims.text: The business centre is on the hotel's highest floor, in the Sky Lobby.

findings.quote: Stay connected at our full-service business centre, located on our highest floor in the Sky Lobby.

claims.text: The hotel bottles its own water in-house, in reusable glass bottles.

findings.quote: by making the switch to reusable glass bottles and an in-house water-bottling facility
findings.note: In-house bottling in reusable glass bottles.

claims.text: Le Petit Chef is a theatrical dinner that pairs a 3D mapping performance with cuisines from across Asia.

findings.quote: Taking theatrical dining to a whole new level, Le Petit Chef features a miniscule chef of French descent
guide patrons to embark on a journey through Asia by witnessing 90 minutes of avant-garde 3D mapping performance and being served tantalizing cuisines from various parts of the continent.
findings.note: 3D mapping performance paired with cuisines from across Asia; hours are evening.

claims.text: JPteres serves authentic Malaysian flavours, set against greenery at the Ground Lobby.

findings.quote: invites diners to embrace our locality through authentic Malaysian flavours
Set against a cove of greenery at the Ground Lobby
findings.note: Location at Ground Lobby amid greenery.

claims.text: The outdoor swimming pool has a view of the Petronas Twin Towers.

findings.quote: with a depth of 1.2 metres and a view of the Petronas Twin Towers
findings.note: Outdoor pool has Twin Towers view.

claims.text: ESSA Spa uses ramuan, the traditional Malay preparation of herbal healing ingredients.

findings.quote: features the powerful benefits of ramuan, the traditional Malay preparation of herbal healing and invigorating ingredients

claims.text: Deluxe corner rooms offer a 180-degree panoramic view of the Kuala Lumpur city skyline.

findings.quote: This spacious 65-square-meter corner room offers a 180-degree panoramic view of the Kuala Lumpur city skyline

claims.text: Guest room bathrooms have a liquid crystal glass cube that can be adjusted for privacy.

findings.quote: a bathroom with a liquid crystal glass cube adjustable for privacy

claims.text: THIRTY8 sits on the 38th floor with a 360-degree view of the city and show kitchens.

findings.quote: Nestled on the 38th floor with a spectacular 360-degree view of the city, THIRTY8 serves exquisite cuisines with lively show kitchens

claims.text: The hotel recommends booking restaurants in advance, as its dining outlets can be full for walk-ins.

findings.quote: our dining outlets may encounter full-house situations where seats will not be available for walk-ins. To avoid disappointment and to help us manage expectations, we strongly recommend making advanced reservations.

claims.text: There are no lifeguards on duty at the pool, and children must be accompanied by an adult.

findings.quote: Please note that there are no lifeguards on duty and that all children must be accompanied by an adult.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city traffic to consider.
